Windscreen Replacers Sydney auto glass, rebuilt to win more quotes.

Windscreen Replacers is a Sydney mobile auto glass specialist and a Nifty client since 2018. We built their original WordPress website, grew it alongside the business, then redesigned it in 2026 on the Nifty Websites AI Builder — faster, sharper and built around smart quote forms that get drivers the right price and advice sooner.

The project

The work in short.

The partnership

Windscreen Replacers has been with us since 2018. We built their first website on WordPress and have backed the business as it has grown across Sydney.

The redesign

In 2026 we rebuilt the site from the ground up on the Nifty Websites AI Builder — a thank-you for a long-term partnership, and a big step up in speed and performance.

The goal

Turn more visitors into quote requests, with conversion rate optimisation built into every page from the first click to the booked job.

The journey

From first site to full rebuild.

  1. 2018

    The original build

    A WordPress website that put Windscreen Replacers online across Sydney, with their services, contact details and an easy way to enquire.

  2. Growing

    More features, more ambition

    As the business grew, so did the wish list: letting drivers select their vehicle make and model, choose the exact service they need, and send a detailed quote request without picking up the phone.

  3. 2026

    The redesign

    A complete rebuild on the Nifty Websites AI Builder for speed, performance and conversion rate optimisation, with custom quote forms at the heart of the site.

Smart quote forms

Forms built to get the right quote, faster.

Getting a windscreen quote shouldn’t mean a round of phone calls. We designed custom forms that ask for exactly what the team needs to price the job the first time — the vehicle, the damage and the service — in a few quick taps.

  • Three simple steps: your details, your vehicle, your message
  • A service selector for car and truck windscreens, chip repairs, rear and side windows
  • Vehicle make, model and year, so the right glass is quoted
  • A body shape picker — hatch, sedan, wagon, SUV, ute, van or truck
  • A quick enquiry option for drivers who just want a call back

Less guesswork for customers, better-qualified leads for the team, and faster answers for drivers who need their glass fixed now.

What we delivered

Everything in the build.

  • Original website design & build (2018)A WordPress site that launched their Sydney mobile auto glass service online.
  • 2026 redesign on the Nifty Websites AI BuilderA fresh, fast rebuild designed for speed and performance.
  • Custom multi-step quote formsService, make, model, year and body shape captured in a few taps.
  • Conversion rate optimisationClear calls to action, click-to-call and quote prompts on every page.
  • Service pages for every jobCar and truck windscreens, chip repairs, rear and side windows, and ADAS calibration.
  • Mobile-first designBuilt for drivers searching on their phone, often right beside the car.
